coder_notes: Registered as EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0/2) - translational subset. 'WHO Grade IV glioma' without IDH requirement with glioblastoma in title/conditions -> gbm_only, historical terminology. Eligibility requires all of (a) RB intact, (b) CDKN2A/B/C loss or CDK4/6 amplification, (c) pERK positivity; (b) coded as two rows (CDKN2A_B and CDK4_6_pathway) because either alternative qualifies. The pERK eligibility quote contains a backslash-escaped '>' as in the record text ('\>30%').
